business_problem: “Our mission at Wilo is to invent and to manage sustainable water solutions that benefit everyone, everywhere. Dynamics 365 helps us achieve our goal of becoming the solution leader for a smart and resource-efficient world.”
solution_summary: The Wilo Group (Wilo) is one of the world’s leading premium suppliers of pumps and pump systems for building services, water management, and industry. More than 9,000 Wilo employees in 90 offices create, deliver, and support innovative, smart, eco-friendly products and services to move water intelligently. From water heating and cooling to complex distribution and critical wastewater treatment solutions, Wilo has supplied the world with high-quality, hard-working systems since 1872. “Our mission at Wilo is to invent and to manage sustainable water solutions that benefit everyone, everywhere. Dynamics 365 helps us achieve our goal of becoming the solution leader for a smart and resource-efficient world.” The implementation centers on Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service.

With earnings in the billions, Wilo was recording substantial growth for the past decade. Always looking to the future, Wilo leaders knew the company would benefit from further streamlined processes and more automated operational systems to better manage its worldwide business operations. “We struggled to connect our teams globally, and knew we needed a solution to bring all our business processes together,” explained Timo Veneman, Group Director, Group Information Management Business Technology & Services.

The Wilo Group (Wilo) is one of the world’s leading premium suppliers of pumps and pump systems for building services, water management, and industry. From water heating and cooling to complex distribution and critical wastewater treatment solutions, Wilo has supplied the world with high-quality, hard-working systems since 1872.
Bastian Schiermeister, Group Vice President Group Information Management Business Technology & Services, Wilo Group
